# Gelabber v0.13.0

A stronger noise filter, a new server overview and unread direct messages
on the server rail, plus security and reliability fixes for sign-in, the
gateway and push. **The upgrade runs four database migrations (0045 to
0048): take a backup first, because going back to v0.12.1 is only possible
by restoring it.** `.env` needs no edit.

## Changes

**Voice and screen share**

- "Enhanced voice: Strong" noise filter with DeepFilterNet3, web and
  desktop: removes keyboard and click noise while someone speaks. Standard
  (RNNoise) stays the default; Strong falls back to it when a device cannot
  keep up, and the voice diagnostics show its block times. #709, #711,
  #712, #715 (GEL-28)
- Sharp Live: viewers past the 64th get the sharp mode too, a failed
  quality floor is retried, and the sharp mode sticks only once it was
  sent. #728 (GEL-67)
- Desktop (Linux): sharing an app's sound no longer reads past PipeWire's
  buffer. #699 (GEL-47)

**Servers, chat and members**

- New server overview that shows only what no other page shows: the
  Lives running now, unread channels with a reply field ("Verpasst") and
  the files shared lately ("Geteilt"), web and desktop. #734, #738
  (GEL-69, GEL-70)
- Unread direct messages show as avatars on the server rail, above the
  servers. #733 (GEL-65)
- Editing an old message in a DM whose peer blocks you no longer answers
  "403 dm_closed": the edit is kept for its sender only. #731 (GEL-21)
- A failed kick, ban, leave or channel change undoes only its own change,
  not changes others made meanwhile. #702 (GEL-54)
- A member who left right after joining no longer comes back in others'
  member lists. #730 (GEL-68)
- Desktop: member rows grow with a wrapped voice line, the profile
  dialog's buttons wrap inside it, and the "Freunde" and "Anfragen" rows
  match the web. #722, #706, #707 (GEL-63, GEL-39, GEL-35)
- The sidebar resize line is 4 px wide and easier to see. #721 (GEL-64)

**Accounts and security**

- Wrong passwords count per account and address: a stranger who guesses
  locks out only their own address, not the owner. #698 (GEL-44)
- `@here` no longer shows which Invisible members are online. #697
  (GEL-43)
- Disabling an account ends its sessions, sockets and voice at once. #704
  (GEL-57)
- Unconfirmed accounts can ask for the confirmation mail again, and
  Betrieb can resend it or confirm an address by hand. #708 (GEL-40)
- Oversized JPEGs no longer get past the pixel limit. #710 (GEL-45)

**Gateway and push**

- Each WebSocket has a budget for the frames its client sends. #703
  (GEL-55)
- A slow-reading member can no longer hold up their own kick or ban. #696
  (GEL-42)
- Web and desktop back off when the gateway closes a fresh socket, instead
  of reconnecting at once. #701 (GEL-51)
- Push: the last-call reminder stops on failures, "call began" goes out
  only for an empty room, recipients are capped and a skipped push gives
  its channel window back. #729 (GEL-66)

**CI and repository**

- Pull-request CI runs with read-only tokens. #700 (GEL-49)
- Extended E2E fault scenarios are reliable again: three green runs in a
  row. #705, #720, #723, #735, #736 (GEL-36)
- The Arch `install.sh` keeps a backup of `pacman.conf`. #684 (GEL-38)

## Upgrade notes

- **Back up first** (`deploy/backup.sh`, see `deploy/README.md` "Backup"),
  or pause Watchtower before this release is published.
- **Four migrations, none reversible without the backup:**
  `0045_hidden_mentions` (`messages.hidden_mentions`, function
  `mentions_seen_by`), `0046_sender_only_edits` (four nullable
  `messages.sender_only_*` columns, no table rewrite),
  `0047_sender_only_content_index` (built `CONCURRENTLY`, outside a
  transaction) and `0048_attachments_sent_by_channel` (partial index on
  `attachments`). If 0047 fails it leaves an invalid index: run
  `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY messages_sender_only_content_idx` before the
  API starts again.
- **Sign-in limit changed meaning:** `API_RATE_LOGIN_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT`
  (default 10) now counts per account and address (IPv6 per /56). New
  optional `API_RATE_LOGIN_FAILURES_ACCOUNT_CEILING` (default 100): past
  it, only addresses the account signed in from get in.
- **New optional variables** for the WebSocket frame budgets,
  `API_RATE_WS_{FRAMES,TYPING,SIG,PRESENCE}_{PER_MIN,BURST}`; the defaults
  fit normal use (`deploy/README.md` "Frames from WebSockets").
- The image pins `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to
  `v0.13.0`. **Rollback:** only by restoring the backup together with the
  v0.12.1 image set.
- **Order:** server first, then clients. Older desktop apps keep working:
  they read "Strong" as Standard and keep their old overview and rail.
- The web image is about 20 MB larger (the DeepFilterNet3 module and
  model, loaded only when someone picks Strong).
- **Desktop:** Windows offers the update itself; Arch: `pacman -Syu`.

All changes: [v0.12.1...v0.13.0](https://github.com/Till-und-Scholler-AI-slop/Gelabber/compare/v0.12.1...v0.13.0)
